preference_rationale:
I actually like B, but the experiment as set up is infeasible for a nontechnical team. You cannot do a 40,000 firm-quarter panel in Excel, and this firm would not be interested in that kind of analysis even if it is stronger statistically. A is much more fundamentals-driven and is what these five people can actually run and defend to an investment committee that distrusts models it cannot inspect.

This is a feasibility call rather than a judgment that A is the better piece of thinking. B asks the more interesting question; it just cannot be asked this way here.
why_loser_was_defensible: B asks the question the seed actually raises - whether the defensive language carries information - and decomposes it correctly into a measurement claim and a predictive one. An analyst at a firm with the technical capacity to run it would take B and would be right to.
